key_findings: (-)-NRG-DM relieved formalin-induced somatic and mustard-oil visceral pain in mice without affecting rotarod performance.
It inhibits IK/Kv2.1 and non-selectively Nav1.7/Nav1.8, dampening DRG neuron firing.
